direction.camera: Guide attention with botanical shadow; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: allow organic shadows to lead toward one quiet subject; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with living curve; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with tactile calm.
direction.lighting: leaf-filtered daylight; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: botanical fibers and warm plaster; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around gentle growth; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use botanical shadow,living curve,warm paper,soft daylight,gentle growth,tactile calm as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
